title: The Delay You Cannot Tune Away
summary: A delay between acting and seeing is the one thing a controller cannot tune around. Past one gain, set by the delay alone, the loop oscillates whatever you do to it.

sources.title: Ziegler and Nichols, Optimum Settings for Automatic Controllers, Trans. ASME 64 (1942)
Astrom and Hagglund, Advanced PID Control (ISA, 2006), chapter on dead time and achievable performance
